options.name: ▸ New here? Start with these
options.description: Upload your logo in Tebex → Webstore → Settings, then fill: accent colours (this tab), your Discord + Docs links (02), the hero text + release package ID (03), reviews and FAQ (04), best-seller IDs (06). Everything else has a sensible default. Seasonal themes (05) switch automatically every month; add daily gift codes there for the holiday calendars. Package descriptions can carry markers (FRAMEWORKS:, VERSION:, RATING:, TAGS:, IMAGES:, VIDEO:, DEPENDENCIES:, CHANGELOG:) that turn into UI, see README.

options.name: Event newyear days
options.description: Daily gift calendar. One entry per day, separated by | . Each entry: Title;CODE;packageId (code and package optional). Example: 10% off everything;SPOOKY10;|Free Notify;FRIGHT;102
